_about: Reference rules for the Vessel Intelligence data layer. Every rule here is a human-reviewable assumption, NOT learned from data. Edit this file (not the code) when NMPA Traffic Dept corrects a classification. Loaded by backend/app/services/vi_reference.py.

waiting_reason_rules._about: Regex (case-insensitive) on the anchorage / tankers-scheduled 'reason_or_note' column, checked in order; first match wins. 'account' mirrors NMPA's monthly Operational Performance split of pre-berthing detention: 'port' = Port Account, 'non_port' = Other than Port Account, 'excluded' = non-cargo calls NMPA does not count, 'unknown' = blank or unreadable.

cargo_class._about: Maps a call's cargo text to NMPA's monthly Operational Performance classes: dry_bulk_conventional, dry_bulk_mechanical, break_bulk, liquid_bulk, container; plus cruise and non_cargo (excluded from KPIs) and unknown. SOR code prefix from sor_wharfage.match_commodity(): A=liquid, B=dry bulk, C=break bulk.

mechanical_dry_bulk._about: Berths whose dry-bulk calls NMPA counts as 'Mechanical' in its monthly Operational Performance report. Calibrated 2026-10-27 against the official August 2026 report: treating Berths 8, 15 and 16 as mechanical reproduces NMPA's split (official: 17 mechanical / 10 conventional; DVP-derived: 18 / 9), while the berths.csv labels alone (15 always, 8 only for pellets) gave 10 / 17. Re-check whenever more monthly reports are loaded (Performance panel).

berth_default_class._about: Used ONLY when a call has no cargo text at all (typically a call seen only in the movement log). Single-purpose berths from berths.csv; the call is flagged 'cargo_class_inferred_from_berth'.

standards._about: Service standards used for alerts. Sources noted per value; thresholds are proposed defaults to be confirmed with Traffic Dept (see PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION/26).

port_account_wait_alert_hours.source: Proposed default; NMPA Aug-2026 Port-Account pre-berthing average was 0.08 days

turnaround_standard_hours.source: NMPA SOR 2026-27 Annexure-II (average turnaround time of vessels)

linking._about: Tolerances used to stitch daily snapshots into port calls. Larger values link more but risk merging two different calls of the same ship.
